title: Delimit finite positive prediction with an exact coherent all-horizon counterfamily
statement: A stationary qubit with irrational theta/pi,unitary real rotations R and projective readout M has exact observable rank3 and p_n=(1+cos(2n theta))/2. Every finite positive stationary classical model has response converging on finite residue classes; the quantum response is dense in[0,1] on each class. No finite positive model realizes all futures exactly,and sup_n final-readout error>=1/2.

requires: The specified exact coherent CP family and arbitrarily long legal horizons
A finite stationary valid stochastic classical realization,allowing any finite hidden-state count
provides: An exact mechanism obstruction beyond square gauges and finite simplex searches
Single-event lower bound also bounds a complete-transcript discrepancy for some finite policy
assumptions: Does not exclude signed OOMs,CP models,finite-horizon models or larger arithmetic-state descriptions
Paid abort clock changes the task and is not covered by the unclocked bound
Standard positive-realization/invariant-cone ancestry is credited; no novel generic quantum/classical separation
costs: Exact supplied analytical family,not shots or an acquisition lower bound
Finite horizons can pay enough classical phase resolution; no efficiency comparison established
contract.units: All-horizon uniform event error for finite positive stationary models
contract.obstruction: Finite CP memory/rank does not imply a finite positive cone. No general-learning impossibility or physical advantage.

evidence.range_scope: Explicit rank3 irrational-rotation obstruction to finite stationary positive all-horizon realization; known ancestry,not CP/signed/finite-horizon impossibility.
